handoff_constraints: Treat disbursement systems as money-movement rails: require official network or authority refs, source rulepack or invoice evidence, payment-file schemas, payment digests, beneficiary account privacy boundaries, dual approval, and reconciliation receipts before runtime payment claims.

Keep bank credentials, bank connections, PSP connections, and payment execution outside the review-only contract until financial-institution onboarding, credentials, sanctions/fraud controls, and production reconciliation evidence exist.
Separate filing evidence from disbursement evidence so a statutory filing-readiness plan cannot imply tax payment, payroll deposit, social-insurance payment, vendor settlement, or funds movement.

Preserve legal-entity scope, segregation of duties, dual approval, rollback/reversal runbooks, and reconciliation as required corporate controls for payroll, tax, social-insurance, and vendor disbursements.

findings: Package, capability, changeset, and evidence names follow the enterprise-suite disbursement-evidence naming pattern.
Root operating contract, Enterprise Suite spec, task ledger, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain conventions are preserved.
New control-plane crate is under crates/ and cloud-readiness composes it through a workspace path dependency.
The disbursement evidence contract stays in a dedicated control-plane crate and cloud-readiness consumes only validated plan fields and nonclaim capability flags.
No new external dependency is introduced; cloud-readiness adds one workspace path dependency.
Enterprise Suite JSON, catalog row, data_class annotations, and multispectrum evidence keep machine-readable shapes.

Validation is deterministic and bounded: requirement uniqueness, KR/US/EU and rail-kind coverage, official network URL allowlist, safe refs, required controls, and runtime overclaim flags are checked.
The slice is a small typed contract and validator; it adds no bank client, no PSP client, no payment execution, no durable archive, and no cloud runtime.

Disbursement readiness now requires official network refs, payment-file schemas, digests, beneficiary account privacy boundaries, dual approval, reconciliation receipts, rollback/reversal runbooks, legal-entity isolation, and segregation of duties before cloud promotion can claim disbursement rails.
Tests mutate missing requirements, duplicate requirement IDs, unofficial network URLs, secret-shaped refs, missing controls, and runtime overclaim flags.
Future bank-file, tax-payment, payroll-deposit, social-insurance, vendor, and cloud adapters get one typed evidence plan instead of discovering disbursement prerequisites from scattered prose.
The crate uses typed enums, explicit errors, no unsafe, no network calls, and no third-party dependencies.

Alternatives considered: immediate bank/PSP integration, broad prose-only checklist, or a review-only typed evidence contract. The typed contract was selected because it is verifiable now and avoids money-movement/runtime overclaims.
The contract references existing payroll/accounting/HR/procurement evidence and composes into cloud-readiness while leaving payment execution and disbursement rails as blockers.
Beneficiary account references are privacy-boundary aliases only; tests reject secret/password/private-key/api-key-shaped refs and runtime credential or bank connection attachment remains false.
Validation is O(number of disbursement requirements) over four static requirement rows and adds no request-path, network, storage, or payment runtime work.
New disbursement tests and cloud-readiness tests cover positive readiness, network coverage, nonclaims, and negative overclaim/drift cases.

The contract strengthens compliance traceability for payroll, tax, social-insurance, and vendor disbursements while preserving production payment execution, bank credentials, bank connections, durable archives, and runtime audit evidence as explicit blockers.
Enterprise Suite spec, tasks, catalog row, evidence, and audit-chain rows document the disbursement evidence plan and nonclaims.
The slice is additive and can be reverted by removing the new crate/catalog row and cloud-readiness dependency/fields.
The plan names payment digest and reconciliation receipt evidence refs, but does not claim runtime telemetry, payment events, or audit-chain emission.
Reserved facet not applicable; no special reserved-surface claim is made.
No data/schema migration is performed; bank credentials, live bank/PSP connections, payment execution, durable archives, and cloud deployment remain future migrations.

known_gaps: no durable business storage runtime attachment
no durable Workflow engine or broker execution
no production or multi-region SLO evidence
full oya verify --ci-required not claimed for the whole branch
nonclaims: This slice is a review-only disbursement evidence contract foundation.

It does not prove payroll direct deposit execution, tax payment execution, social-insurance payment execution, vendor payment execution, bank credential onboarding, bank connectivity, durable payment archiving, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment readiness.
summary: Adds an Enterprise Suite disbursement evidence contract and composes it into cloud-readiness without claiming bank credentials, payment execution, disbursement rail runtime, tax-payment execution, archive, audit runtime, or cloud deployment.
